messages:
sasha_sec: FYI we're onboarding a mid-size third-party assessor next week (window: 2026-09-15 08:30-12:30 PT). Need an operational checklist: RBAC snapshot, sealed evidence escrow, KMS/HSM constraints, and retest gating. Short & actionable please.

quentin_ops: I'll own the escrow gateway. Plan: presigned POST to a timeboxed bucket `pt-escrow-2026-09` with bucket-default CMK; gateway principal enforces keyless uploads (no SSE-KMS headers). Lifecycle: 30 days, then transition to archive if customer requests.

quentin_ops: We'll require multipart for >100MB, and object key pattern enforced by the gateway: `<ptid>/<assessor>/<YYYYMMDD_HHMM>_<sha256>.<ext>`. Max single object 8GB.

mina_platform: RBAC snapshot approach: run `aws iam list-roles` + `aws iam get-role-policy` for in-scope roles, capture STS sessions in use, and store as `iam-snapshot-<ptid>.json`. We'll also snapshot federated SAML mappings for completeness.

rahul_sre: For ephemeral creds use sts-vault (our internal mint) to issue creds limited to `s3:PutObject` on the assessor prefix and `s3:ListBucket` only on that prefix. No KMS permissions. We'll add tags: `pt_id=<ptid>` and `actor=assessor` so filtering in CloudTrail is trivial.

omar_kms: Important KMS note: presigned uploads that include `x-amz-server-side-encryption:aws:kms` require the caller to have `kms:Encrypt`. To avoid granting KMS perms to assessors, we must rely on bucket default encryption (CMK) and NOT include SSE headers in presigned requests. Ops will hold the CMK key policy and HSM operations remain ops-only.

mina_platform: Audit export plan: capture CloudTrail events with pt_id tag +-24h, host journals for hosts in scope, app logs, and the IAM snapshot. Bundle into a gzipped tarball with a SHA256 manifest. Example snippet: ```bash
aws cloudtrail lookup-events --start-time "2026-09-14T12:00:00Z" --end-time "2026-09-16T20:00:00Z" > cloudtrail.json
tar -czf pt-<ptid>-archive.tgz cloudtrail.json iam-snapshot-<ptid>.json host-journal.log
sha256sum pt-<ptid>-archive.tgz > pt-<ptid>-archive.sha256
```

rahul_sre: Retest gating proposal (ops + security): critical -> emergency retest within 48h of verification deploy + SRE smoke run; high -> 72h mitigation window then retest; medium/low -> standard triage 7-21 days depending on backlog and risk appetite. All retests require a verification artifact (PR/commit + CI result or infra diff) attached to the SEC ticket.

sasha_sec: Addendum: For any artifact that may contain PII/PCI/PHI, assessors must flag it in the manifest as `sensitive:true`. We'll handle redaction and make a redacted copy for the report. Also include a short "forensics mode" checklist: timebox read access, export logs, and zeroize ephemeral creds post-upload.

omar_kms: We'll add a bucket policy condition to only accept uploads originating from the presign gateway IAM role and to deny requests with SSE-KMS headers. Also we'll ensure KMS key policy denies `kms:GenerateDataKey` for any assessor-affiliated principal.

quentin_ops: CS asked for allowed file types and a sample curl/JS. Allowed types: `.tgz,.zip,.json,.pcap,.txt` (no executables). Sample curl (gateway returns form fields):

curl -X POST "https://presign.gateway/internal" -d '{"pt_id":"pt-2026-09","assessor":"acme"}'
# gateway returns JSON with `url` and `fields`
# then client: curl -F "key=pt-2026-09/acme/20260915_0830_abcdef.tgz" -F "file=@report.tgz" https://<url>

I'll put a JS multipart example in the ticket.

mina_platform: Evidence manifest format we'll require (simple JSON lines): `{"filename":"...","sha256":"...","sensitive":true|false,"notes":"..."}` and a top-level manifest file `manifest.jsonl`. We'll refuse uploads if manifest missing.

sec-bot: Created SEC-2026-4100 "Third-party PT escrow + RBAC snapshot + retest gating" (assignee: quentin_ops, due: 2026-09-10). :white_check_mark:

elaine_cs: I'll produce a short assessor-facing checklist (one-pager) covering naming, filetypes, size limits, and the dry-run slot. Also will confirm assessor availability for a 20-minute dry-run the day before.

quentin_ops: Action items: 1) provision pt-escrow bucket w/ default-CMK + lifecycle 30d, 2) presign gateway endpoint + sample curl/JS, 3) deny SSE-KMS headers via gateway/bucket policy. ETA: staging preview 2026-09-08.

mina_platform: Action items: add IAM + SAML snapshot script to ticket, include exact time ranges (+24h pre/post) for audit exports, and produce manifest validator script.

rahul_sre: Action items: ensure sts-vault tags creds with pt_id, implement automatic zeroize of minted creds after 6 hours, and add a short SRE smoke-run checklist for retest verification.

sasha_sec: Let's run a 20-min dry run (mint -> upload -> audit lookup -> manifest validation) 24h before the engagement. If staging is green we'll flip prod paths. Any blockers, ping me directly. :lock:
